summary:
NovaHealth is an offline-first, web-based health monitoring and decision-support tool engineered for long-duration space missions. We developed an intuitive dashboard featuring an interactive anatomical body map, multi-modal telemetry inputs, dynamic historical trend charts, and an intelligent diagnostic engine.

The software directly addresses the NASA Space Apps challenge by translating NASA’s Human Research Program (HRP) guidelines into practical, crew-operated care. It maps critical health indicators—such as sleep hours, cardiovascular metrics, and metabolic markers—against the primary hazards of human spaceflight, using instant color-coded status alerts to flag deviations.

NovaHealth is vital for deep-space exploration, such as lunar bases and Mars transits, where communication delays with Earth make real-time ground support impossible. By empowering astronauts to autonomously assess their health, follow structured diagnostic workflows, and determine when crew medical officer intervention is required, NovaHealth ensures crew safety and operational resilience far from Earth.
details:
NovaHealth is an offline-first, web-based autonomous health monitoring and decision-support system designed specifically for astronauts on long-duration space missions.

How It Works & Key Features The application processes multi-modal health inputs—such as biometric telemetry, sleep hours, blood sugar, and radiation logs—through an intelligent diagnostic engine. It features an Interactive Anatomical Body Map divided into key sectors (Head/CNS, Cardiovascular, Metabolic/Abdomen, and Musculoskeletal). Astronauts can click on any body region to instantly inspect health indicators mapped against NASA's Human Research Program (HRP) hazards. Metrics are categorized using intuitive color-coding (Green for nominal, Yellow for moderate deviation, Red for critical attention) to allow for rapid self-assessment at a glance.

Benefits & Intended Impact NovaHealth provides total mission autonomy by operating entirely offline, making it impervious to the severe 20-minute communication blackout delays experienced during deep-space transit to Mars. By automating medical triage and providing clear guidance—explaining what an exam measures, why it is needed, and when it requires intervention—the tool significantly reduces astronaut cognitive load under high-stress conditions. Its intended impact is to safeguard human life and operational continuity as humanity pushes further into the cosmos through Artemis and future Mars missions.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend Framework: React with Vite for high-performance rendering
  • Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS (NASA Mission Control dark-mode aesthetic) and Lucide React iconography
  • Data Visualization: Recharts for dynamic, multi-week health telemetry trend charts
  • Development Architecture: Built and optimized using modern AI-assisted engineering tools for rapid prototyping and deployment

Innovation & Design Considerations NovaHealth transforms complex clinical data into an engaging, spatial user experience via an interactive visual body map rather than dense spreadsheets. In designing the solution, the team explicitly accounted for the five primary spaceflight hazards (space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity fields, and hostile closed environments), minimized click-depth to combat astronaut fatigue, and anchored the architecture in an offline-first design philosophy.
